texts.title: Tahdhīb al-Manṭiq
texts.author: Saʿd al-Dīn al-Taftāzānī
texts.note: 19 bilingual divisions of the Cairo 1912 logic matn restored in source order, including repaired L.11 modalities and removal of an unwitnessed commentary addition in L.16. Explanatory notes and the النظريات/فطريات variant recorded; independent manuscript collation not complete. Optional al-Yazdī commentary: 177 archived source-linked selections across L.01–L.19; the reader now uses 113 consecutive Arabic–English main-text blocks across 110 distinct printed Qum source positions (pp.7–19, 22–37, 39–51, 54–123; Q20–21, Q38, Q52–53, Q85, Q109 without independently delimited running main text). Two 55-source-page translation batches are linked in the compact reader. All 19 logic divisions have a first-pass main-source translation, but independent photographic/manuscript collation is not certified; Q37 remains textually uncertain and the p123 completion notice is not attributed to the author instead of overlapping excerpt cards. Remaining sections are sampled, and photographic/manuscript collation is incomplete; the commentary is not fully translated or definitively edited.
